name: DateInput
description: A component combining a calendar button with a text input for selecting and displaying date values in YYYY-MM-DD format.
usage: Provides both calendar picker and manual text input methods.
A native text field: onChange receives the native ChangeEvent; event.target.value is the masked YYYY-MM-DD date, whether typed or picked from the calendar
Controlled with value, or uncontrolled with defaultValue
Text input includes automatic formatting to enforce YYYY-MM-DD pattern as user types.
Built-in validation for date format and validity (e.g., rejects Feb 30) shows after the first blur; an error the app passes shows at once unless touched is false
Forwards refs to the underlying text input element; unnamed props (name, aria-*, data-*, onFocus…) go to it too.
design: The component wraps a clickable calendar button and a text input.
The calendar dropdown uses a Portal and is positioned relative to the viewport to avoid clipping.
onChange receives a real ChangeEvent from the text input; a calendar pick sets the input's value and dispatches a native input event
Sizes from the input scale ('2xs' to 'lg', utils/inputSizing.ts), default 'md'
Styling aims to visually merge the button and text input, resembling the `TextInput` component but with the prepended button.
Uses design system tokens for borders, focus rings, text colors, and error states.
accessibility: The calendar button has an `aria-label` and aria-expanded; the calendar opens in a role="dialog" and Escape closes it
The text input carries aria-invalid and aria-describedby (the error or helper, merged with any aria-describedby passed in)
The calendar is a WAI-ARIA date grid: one Tab stop, arrows by day and week, Home/End the week, PageUp/PageDown the month
Named by its label (htmlFor/id), or by aria-label / aria-labelledby passed through

props.name: id
props.description: The input's id; generated with useId() when left out

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. Without it, pass aria-label or aria-labelledby

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled: the date, YYYY-MM-DD ('' for none). Leave out for uncontrolled

props.name: onChange
props.description: The native change event; event.target.value is the masked date, typed or picked

props.name: error
props.description: The app's error message: shows at once unless touched is false; replaces the helper text

props.name: validate
props.description: Your own check; its message (like the format check's) shows after the first blur, or when touched is true

props.name: helperText
props.description: Text displayed below the input when not in an error state.

props.name: touched
props.description: Leave out to show an error the app passes at once; pass the field's touched state to hold it until the field is left. false hides errors

props.name: className
props.description: CSS classes for the outer container div, merged with cn() so yours win.

props.name: inputClassName
props.description: CSS classes specifically for the text <input> element.

props.name: buttonClassName
props.description: CSS classes specifically for the calendar <button> element.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Function called when the text input loses focus.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the input as required (adds asterisk to label).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the input and calendar button.

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Every other prop (name, aria-*, data-*, onFocus…) goes to the text input
